thread:
maya: Heads-up — prototyping an "auto-fallback lifecycle" flow for the Console. Main goals: 1) show why a request fell back, 2) link the decision to the audit log + operator who intervened, 3) let us replay the decision in sandbox (no live traffic).
liam: SG. Can we include the raw decision payload (matched rule id, signal values, thresholds) when available? That'd make triage much faster.
sofia: +1 but keep PII out. We should only surface sanitized signals or a hashed context id. Need a privacy gating checkbox for security reviews.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging rollout v0.23 pushed to canary :rocket: (noisy)
maya: Sketch idea: add a "Decision inspector" drawer on the rollout detail page. Timeline: matched-rule -> reason -> fallback-target -> cost delta -> operator actions -> replay button. Also show a small graph of the triggering metric.
liam: Replay should run in a sandboxed dry-run mode and produce a diff: "what would have happened" vs "what actually happened". Do not mutate routing state.
sofia: Also audit entries when an operator applies a sticky override: include operator id, TTL, justification text. These need to be exportable for compliance.
ops-jordan: Quick question — how should quotas interact with fallbacks? If quota exhausted, do we route to a cheaper model or return an error? Need precedence and visible explanation in the UI.
maya: Proposed precedence: operator override > quota-based fallback > latency-trigger fallback > model-health fallback > hard reject. Open to pushback.
liam: Edge case: oscillation when quota briefly recovers and fallback flips back and forth. Need hysteresis (cooldown windows) and a visible "cooldown remaining" indicator in the inspector.
sofia: Agree. Also retention for decision payloads — propose 90 days default, configurable per org. Add data-retention UI and a link to the privacy policy.
maya: Example policy snippet for the backend (for discussion):
```json
{
  "id": "fallback_policy_112",
  "triggers": [
    {"metric": "latency_p95", "op": ">", "value": 1200},
    {"metric": "error_rate", "op": ">", "value": 0.05}
  ],
  "actions": [
    {"type": "route", "target": "small-model-v1", "ttl": "5m", "cooldown": "2m"}
  ]
}
```
liam: That TTL/cooldown combo looks reasonable. For the UI, show both TTL and cooldown as separate badges.
ops-jordan: For operator ergonomics: add a lightweight undo for overrides ("revert override") and surface any recent overrides in the rollout timeline.
maya: Good call. I'll add a mock with those affordances.
liam: I'll mock screenshots tomorrow and attach to this thread. Ping me @maya for review.
maya: :thumbsup: Also logged: follow-up items — retention defaults, privacy gating, precedence docs, and replay sandbox scope.
sofia: Filing a doc stub in Confluence for retention & privacy.
maya: Thanks all — this is the shape I wanted. We'll iterate on mockups and edgecases in follow-ups.
